notes: Open with the last thing you'd normally say.
Write it as advice to one specific kind of reader.
Lead with the single most concrete detail in the story.
Disagree, politely, with the most common reaction to this story.
Make it half the length you'd naturally write.
End on a question the reader can answer from their own work.
swap: This take must land somewhere different from the earlier ones: keep the facts true to the story, but come at it from a different angle, reader or consequence. Don't repeat their opening, their structure or their key phrase. Still the brand's voice.
